integrity: The primary 2026 article was inspected in its publisher full PDF at the copula definition, parameter restriction, uniform-margin correlation, illustrative examples, and discussion/conclusion. The original Kimeldorf–Sampson work was compared at its polynomial extension and admissibility discussion, with explicit acknowledgment of degraded extracted formulas. scientific_limitations: The exact envelope optimizes Spearman rank correlation only, not arbitrary-marginal Pearson correlation.
The result concerns the full copula-valid parameter domain; the source deliberately fitted a smaller rectangular domain, where its stated bound remains correct.
An archival source has partially lossy mathematical extraction, leaving a bounded originality risk.
title: A sharp Spearman envelope beyond the restricted Kimeldorf–Sampson copula box
